prose: Bert Hubert (English version of a Dutch post) sets out simple, malice-free scenarios in which AI still disrupts economies horribly. After mocking the prediction business - 'anyone making ChatGPT forecasts is now making a total fool of themselves' - he makes his own: no evil plans needed from humans or AI for things to go badly wrong.
He sidesteps the 'truly intelligent' debate and the error-rate argument to focus on structural economic disruption from systems that merely work as advertised.
highlights: Hubert offers AI disruption scenarios requiring no malicious intent from anyone
He mocks AI forecasting, including his own, citing how bad humans are at prediction
The essay deliberately ignores the 'is it truly intelligent' debate
Focus is economic disruption from AI that works as advertised, not AI gone rogue
English machine-aided translation of a Dutch original, also available in German
